# space-screener-sdk

> Space Terminal screeners are Rust libraries compiled to wasm32-unknown-unknown (no WASI) and run by the terminal in an Extism sandbox. The plugin has no network, files, clock or threads: it calls host functions for data and HTTP and emits table rows. Crate `space-screener` (PDK), CLI `st`. Full contract: ABI.md. Agent guide: SKILL.md.

## Workflow
- `st init <dir> --id author.name` → Cargo.toml (cdylib), manifest.yaml, src/lib.rs
- `st build` → screener.wasm + the terminal's validation (manifest, imports, exports)
- `st dev` → install into the running terminal, open a pane, rebuild/reinstall on save, print log
- `st rows [--json]`, `st logs [-f]`, `st list` → inspect the running plugin
- Terminal discovery: token `<data>/screeners/local_api_token`, port `<data>/config/general.yaml` (5055); `<data>` = `SPACE_TERMINAL_DIR` or OS data dir `Space Terminal`

## Code
- `use space_screener::prelude::*;` `#[derive(Default)] struct S;` `impl Screener for S { fn on_timer(&mut self, now_ms: i64) -> ScreenerResult {…} }` `export_screener!(S);`
- Optional: `init(&mut self, &Init)`, `on_params(&mut self, &Params)`; `params()`, `lang()` anywhere
- Clicks: rows with symbol/exchange/market open their order book at once without plugin code. Custom `on_click(&mut self, &Click)` only with `export_screener!(S, on_click)`; such clicks wait for a running on_timer — keep rounds short
- Panics are logged with message and location (`st logs`) before the plugin restarts
- Host: `http(&HttpRequest::get(url))`, `http_batch(&reqs)` (8 concurrent, use for per-symbol endpoints), `tickers(ex, Market::Futures)`, `symbols(ex, market)`, `exchanges()`, `history_cluster`, `history_replay`, `kv_get/kv_set/kv_delete` (≤1 MiB), `replace_rows/emit_rows/expire`, `set_status(tone, text)`, `alert/alert_row` (≤6/min), `open_market/open_spread` (only in on_click), `now_ms()`, `info!/warn!/error!/debug!`
- Symbols in rows/open_market: canonical upper-case BASEQUOTE (BTCUSDT, Hyperliquid BTCUSDC) recommended, native symbol also resolved; tickers()/symbols() return the terminal symbol + base/quote
- Row: `Row::new(key).market_ref(&MarketRef::new(ex, Market::Futures, sym)).cell("col", value).cell("chg", Cell::signed(x)).rank(n).ttl_s(s)`; cells keys = manifest column keys; ≤5000 rows
- `Series::new(mins(16))`: `push(ts, v)`, `change_pct(now, mins(5))`; `secs/mins/hours` → ms
- `space_screener::oi::Collector::new().collect(now_ms)?` → open interest (one side, USD) for binance, bybit, okx, bitget, gate, mexc, kucoin, hyperliquid; hosts in `oi::HOSTS`; Snapshot `is_complete()`/`summary()` ("binance 180/200"); items: canonical `symbol`, `native_symbol`
- Binance OI is per symbol and fapi.binance.com is capped at 5 req/s by the terminal: N symbols ≈ N/5 s; the collector takes the top 200 by 24h volume (`set_binance_top_n(n)`, 1..=600, 600 = all)

## Manifest
- Required: `abi: 1`, `id` (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{2,63}$), `version` (semver), `name {ru,en}`, `lang: rust`, `min_terminal: 0.104.70`
- `http: [bare.host.names]` (every host called), `timer_ms` (250..=3600000), `columns [{key, type, title{ru,en}, sort?: asc|desc, width?}]`, `params [{key, type, title, default, min?, max?, options?}]`, `limits {memory_mb ≤64, cpu_ms_per_call ≤1000}`, `history?: [cluster, replay]`, `feeds: []` (v1)
- Column types: text number integer percent usd price time duration countdown symbol exchange exchanges bool; param types: number integer bool text select

## Limits and pitfalls
- 64 MB memory, cpu_ms_per_call of wasm CPU (default 250; HTTP wait excluded), 3 overruns → stopped; http timeout ≤10 s, body ≤8 MiB
- One call including HTTP waits must finish within 600 s wall; Binance per-symbol round ≈ N/5 s
- No std::time/fs/net/thread, no println (use info!), no wasm-bindgen deps (getrandom js, chrono wasmbind); extism-pdk logging/http imports are refused
- Exchange slugs lowercase (binance, bybit, okx, bitget, gate, mexc, kucoin, bingx, hyperliquid); markets spot|futures
- Install st: `cargo install --path <sdk-checkout>/crates/st` (st init then uses that checkout); the git URL works after the SDK repo is published
